purpose: Pre-register a candidate control/checkpoint partition for a controlled ODM rehearsal; this is not an accuracy result or release decision.

selection.method: Greedy farthest-point sampling in horizontal LV95 coordinates among observed points with at least five image observations. Start with the eligible point farthest from the eligible-point centroid; iteratively add the point maximizing its minimum Euclidean distance to the selected controls. Resolve ties by lexicographic point ID.

excluded_source_record.reason: No image observation; coordinates duplicate point 206, as explicitly documented by the publisher.

validation_caveats: The 8 proposed controls each have observations in at least five images, consistent with ODM guidance for GCP observation coverage.

The 19 proposed checkpoints have source-provided Metashape image observations. These have not yet been independently remeasured or blind-reviewed; they must not be represented as independent human reference measurements.
The supplied OPK orientations are from a Metashape adjustment that used ground points as control and are not used as independent reference.
Point 100 is not a separate independent point because it duplicates point 206 and has no image observation.
Points 102, 200 and 303 are withheld from this primary split because they have fewer than five image observations; they may be considered in a separately declared sensitivity exercise.

The horizontal CRS is EPSG:2056 and the source heights are LN02. The ODM GCP file format declares the horizontal projection; vertical reference handling and output height interpretation must be explicitly checked.
This split remains proposed_not_locked until a human reviewer confirms point visibility, image measurements, spatial coverage and the control/checkpoint separation.
